headword: {単純作業|たんじゅんさぎょう}
gloss: simple repetitive work; routine task; menial work

definitions.gloss: simple repetitive work; routine task; menial work
definitions.explanation: Work requiring little thought or skill that involves repeating the same actions.

notes:
